gates.policy: G-F3 and G-F4 are advisory: a newer injury release or a tip inside the cutoff is reported, not fatal, because the site must still show what it knows. Everything in the hard set is fatal.

crosschecks.note: Both columns are official. The advanced page implies a points-allowed figure from DefRtg x POSS; the opponent page prints Opp PTS directly. They disagree by up to the amount shown because the two pages estimate team possessions differently (offensive and defensive possession counts are not identical). Nothing is averaged: the model uses the advanced-page pair for internal consistency and prints the opponent-page figure beside it.

flags.finding: The repeat matchups the previous snapshot flagged as a possible page artifact are CONFIRMED genuine on the official schedule rendered this session: POR @ MIN plays on both 2026-11-16 (0022600250, final 98-106) and 2026-11-17 (0022600254), and NYK @ TOR on both 2026-11-15 (0022600241, 112-108 OT) and 2026-11-17 (0022600253), each pair in the same arena. The 2026-11-13 slate_context anomaly note is thereby resolved.

Official game IDs are not monotonic in tip order inside 2026-11-18: BOS@DEN is 0022600266 but tips at 9:30 PM ET, after GSW@DAL which is 0022600267 and tips at 8:00 PM ET. Do not use game ID as a date proxy.

The 11/17 11:00 AM ET release prints an explicit NOT YET SUBMITTED row for both POR@MIN clubs while the day-before deadline for the 11/18 games had not yet passed, so those 16 club rows are absent-by-rule rather than late. Also in this release: Walker Kessler's reason ends at 'Right Lower Leg' where the page-continuation renders a stray 'Soreness' cell; the join basis is recorded in the committed transcript rather than merged silently, and the later 11:15+ releases supersede it.

Quarter scores are captured for 8 of 9 finals on 11/15 (the DAL away row is blank in the committed feed) and all 8 finals on 11/16 (official gamebook PDFs). Four of the five 11/14 finals still carry blank quarter columns with their game URL; nothing was estimated.

RESOLVED this session: the previous snapshot had only 16 of 30 PTS rows inside its fetched chunks and derived the rest. The traditional page was re-read in five chunks and PTS was read for all 30 clubs; pts_for stays derived from OffRtg x POSS for internal consistency and the official read is published beside it in the cross-checks.

No arena coordinates: NBA.com publishes arena, city and state but no lat/lon, and no official geocoder is reachable. Travel distance is blank for every game; rest, back-to-back and 3-in-4 are computed from the official schedule dates.

odds: Market prices (spread, total, moneyline, prop lines)

No licensed odds feed is connected and NBA.com renders odds client-side only. Without a price there is no edge, no CLV, no ROI and no stake sizing, so every bet-surface stake is held at 0.00 and only a trigger price is published.
